Regular post:
Your website is online. Let's find out whether your business is getting found.

The way people search has changed. They still use Google. They also ask AI to help them find a business. Your site needs to explain what you do, who you serve, and where you work in a way people and search systems can understand.

Then comes the part that matters to your business: someone reaches out. Does the form work? Is booking clear? Does anyone follow up?

Modern Mustard Seed is offering a free audit of your website and online presence.

We'll check:
• SEO: how search engines can find and understand your pages.
• AIO: how clearly your business is represented for AI search.
• Your public business information and the path from visitor to inquiry.
• Forms, booking, and opportunities to automate follow-up.

You'll get the findings in plain English, with a clear order for what to address first. The audit is free. You don't need to know the acronyms or buy anything.

Publishing sequence:
1. Publish the vertical reel with the Reel caption and pin the supplied comment. Set reel-cover.jpg as the cover.
2. Share the three Story cards in order. Use the Story caption with a reply prompt on the final card.
3. Publish feed-post.jpg with the Regular post copy the following day. Use the supplied replies to collect websites from people who ask for an audit.
Two strategic angles:
1. Show one real finding from an audit, with the business owner's permission. A concrete broken booking path or missing service page demonstrates the value more clearly than an abstract AI score.
2. Measure qualified audit requests and the inquiries recovered after fixes. Views measure attention. Website submissions and working follow-up show business value.
Operating note: The campaign uses comment and message intake. Reply copy is supplied for manual use; no automatic reply workflow has been connected. Public checks can assess visible forms and booking paths. Internal CRM and follow-up automation need the owner's walkthrough or authorized access. The audit identifies opportunities; implementation is not included in the free audit.
Claim reference: Google Search Central explains that foundational SEO practices also apply to Google's AI features: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ai-features . The campaign does not promise AI recommendations, a search position, or a number of leads.
